transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Hello, Dr. Smith. Honestly, I've just been feeling incredibly anxious, down, and completely overwhelmed lately. It feels like everything is piling up, and I'm really struggling to cope with it all.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been going on for about four months now. It started pretty soon after a major change in my life, and I just haven't been able to shake it since.
Can you tell me more about the major change that happened around that time?
I'm not entirely sure how to describe it, but it was just a lot of big shifts happening all at once in my life. Everything suddenly felt very different, and I've really struggled to adapt to it.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, or do you still find pleasure in them sometimes?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't thought much about it lately because I've just been so overwhelmed with everything else.
Even when you do the things you used to enjoy, do you still get any pleasure from them, or does nothing feel satisfying anymore?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't actually tried doing those things lately, so I haven't thought about whether they would still bring me any pleasure.
How much is this affecting your ability to work, take care of responsibilities, or interact with others?
Honestly, it has been quite difficult to handle my daily routine lately. Everything just feels like a struggle, and I'm really finding it hard to keep up with things.
Have these symptoms been present most days for the past two years, or have they come and gone?
No, it definitely hasn't been going on for two years. These feelings only started recently and have been pretty constant for about the past four months.
Would you say your symptoms began within three months of the life changes you mentioned?
Yes, absolutely. They started almost immediately, within just a couple of weeks after everything changed. It was definitely well within that three-month window.
